an4.258:1.1: “In every case where a family cannot hold onto its great wealth for long, it is for one or another of these four reasons.
an4.258:1.3: They don’t look for things that are lost. They don’t repair things that have gotten old. They are immoderate in consuming food and drink. They place a woman or man of no virtue or principles in the position of authority.
an4.258:1.4: In every case where a family cannot hold onto its great wealth for long, it is for one or another of these four reasons.
an4.258:2.1: “In every case where a family can hold onto its great wealth for long, it is for one or another of these four reasons.
an4.258:2.3: They look for things that are lost. They repair things that have gotten old. They are moderate in consuming food and drink. They place a virtuous, principled woman or man in the position of authority.
an4.258:2.4: In every case where a family can hold onto its great wealth for long, it is for one or another of these four reasons.”
